source.quote: FiiO's own parameters page, read 2026-11-24. « Hardware solution », as four printed lines: « SoC: GD32F303RE, DAC:CS43198 », « USB decoding: SA9312L », « SPDIF decoding: MS8422N », « AMP: SGM8262-2*2 ». « Max supported sampling rate » rows (the page prints no period after « supported »): « 384kHz-32bit/DSD256  Native 16/24/32bit (USB DAC) »; « 192kHz-24bit (Coaxial) »; « 96KHz-24bit (Optical) ». No filter, oversampling or NOS row; no Bluetooth row; nothing about R2R, ladder or delta-sigma.

facts.chip: CS43198 (Cirrus Logic), with an SA9312L as USB receiver and an MS8422N for S/PDIF - this page is unusual in naming the S/PDIF receiver separately from the USB one.
